description: MainActivity.kt is an Android activity written in Kotlin that manages the main UI for a biometric authentication demo app. It handles UI interactions, observes authentication state and logs, and coordinates biometric prompts, authentication, and navigation to a home activity.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing the main demo screen for biometric authentication, login/logout, session lock/unlock, and navigation to the home screen. It handles user interactions, observes authentication states, and manages biometric prompts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, wires button click handlers, and starts collecting flows for auth state and status log.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles activity startup, checks auth state, and prompts unlock if returning from background.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves state related to ongoing biometric prompt.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Marks the app as backgrounded; enforces lock on return.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels flow collection jobs to prevent leaks.

methods.name: wireClicks
methods.description: Sets click listeners for UI buttons to trigger view model actions.

methods.name: observeAuthState
methods.description: Collects and reacts to changes in authentication state, updating UI and navigating as necessary.

methods.name: observeStatusLog
methods.description: Collects logs and displays them in the UI.

methods.name: setButtonsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables buttons based on current auth or session state.

methods.name: maybePromptUnlock
methods.description: Initiates biometric or device credential prompt if session is locked and user initiates unlock.

methods.name: routeToHomeIfUnlocked
methods.description: Navigates to home activity if session is unlocked.

methods.name: routeToHome
methods.description: Performs navigation to the HomeActivity, ensuring idempotency.
